answer: We formulate a decentralized protocol where participants commit staking collateral as a security anchor within a subgame-perfect slashing matrix to prevent identity multiplication. This mechanism enforces a glacier of illiquid capital via dynamic opportunity-cost bonds, ensuring the marginal expenditure for additional nodes exceeds any extractive reward. By utilizing zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions, the system pushes adversaries onto a terminal ledge where negative expected utility guarantees convergence toward a strict Nash equilibrium.
